Introduction

JJ is a South Korean rapper and singer. He was a member of the boy group DUSTIN and its sub-unit DUSTIN-ON under Na Entertainment but left the group on May 24, 2021. He made his solo debut on September 7, 2025 with the digital single "GWANG-GI (Madness)".

In 2023, he participated in MBN's survival show "Show King Night" as part of the group ZeroNine along with former fellow member Hwani. His team made it to the final.
